description: List URIs of your saved tracks or albums whose artists carry a given genre tag (case-insensitive tag-name match against your sidecar). Output is directly usable as create_playlist / add_to_playlist input. Read-only.

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: filter_by_genre
